notes: Sanctum of All. Printed: 'If an ability of another Shrine you control triggers while you control six or more Shrines, that ability triggers an additional time.' Only Shrines you control: seat 0 controls six Shrines (Sanctum of All and five plain ones); seat 1 controls Sanctum of Stone Fangs. On seat 1's turn-2 first main phase its Stone Fangs triggers once, X = 1 (seat 1 controls one Shrine): seat 1 gains 1 (21), seat 0 loses 1 (19). It is not doubled.
